text:
Brady Tkachuk spent seven seasons as the face of the Senators, and now he's a Panther, playing on his brother's team. It's working. Twenty points in 19 games, 10 goals, and 14 of those points on a Florida power play that has needed him with Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand out.

Nothing about the scoring looks lucky. His finishing is right on his expected goals (9.2, a big total), and Florida's on-ice shooting is exactly normal with him out there. By our win probability his goals have added more wins than all but eight skaters in the league. He's still Brady, too: he dropped the gloves with Nikita Zadorov off the opening faceoff against Boston.

Evolving-Hockey had him in the 99th percentile for driving offense last season. This week he and Matthew drew a backlash over a Veterans Day post, per Yahoo Sports. Our range has him at 29 to 45 goals, on pace for the high end now.
